label: [ Passoff Reading 204 ]

blocks.text: Many popular sayings are correct, even insightful, when applied to life's circumstances. But when proverbs are viewed without qualifications: they can cancel each other out. For instance, while it's often true that " too many cooks spoil the broth ," there are times when " two heads are better than one.
